name: Lysergine
summary: Lysergine, also known as 9,10-didehydro-6,8β-dimethylergoline, is an ergot alkaloid and serotonin receptor agonist of the ergoline family. It is a minor constituent of ergot.

pharmacology.text: Lysergine shows selectivity for activation of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor over several other closely related serotonin receptors (54-fold over the 5-HT2B receptor, 38-fold over the 5-HT2C receptor, and 127-fold over the 5-HT1A receptor). The drug is a partial agonist of the 5-HT2A receptor with moderate intrinsic activity (Emax = 57%).

uses.en: It is a minor ergot alkaloid studied in laboratory research on serotonin receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是一種含量很少的麥角生物鹼，用於血清素受體的實驗室研究，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种含量很少的麦角生物碱，用于血清素受体的实验室研究，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: Lysergine is one of the simplest ergot alkaloids: it has the same ergoline ring system as LSD, but with just a methyl group where LSD carries its diethylamide.
fact.zh: Lysergine 是最簡單的麥角生物鹼之一：它和 LSD 擁有相同的麥角靈環系，只是在 LSD 接二乙醯胺的位置上只有一個甲基。
fact.zhHans: Lysergine 是最简单的麦角生物碱之一：它和 LSD 拥有相同的麦角灵环系，只是在 LSD 接二乙酰胺的位置上只有一个甲基。
